title: Red Happy's single beat, seen in 1919
summary: Frazier says Red Happy played the same beat on everything, even some blues numbers, and that he saw this in 1919.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. And he beat the same, how about the blues? He wouldn't beat the blues? The blues numbers, well no, some of the blues numbers he used to play on this order.
Oh yeah, so he played the same beat every whatever he was playing, the same beat.
That's the experience I had with him, yeah.
Well, when was it that you saw him playing like that? What year?
That was in the year of 1919 at the Old Lyric Theatre.
